job.title: Junior Database & Backend Developer
job.description: FinMetric Solutions in Mumbai is hiring a Junior Backend Developer focused on relational databases, query optimization, and secure API layers. You will write stored procedures, optimize slow queries, manage PostgreSQL schemas, and expose backend endpoints in Node.js or Python.

pool.text: PostgreSQL Administration & SQL: expert in query plans, partial indexes, CTEs, and window functions
Database Migration & Schema Design: normalized tables to 3NF and managed migrations safely
Node.js & TypeScript Backend: exposed REST endpoints consuming database views and stored procedures
Database Benchmarking: simulated 10,000 concurrent writes using pgbench and analyzed contention
QueryOptimizerLab: academic research project comparing execution plans of nested subqueries vs CTEs
Redis Caching: set up LRU caching policy for hot database query results
CSS Grid & Flexbox: created responsive web pages for college blog
Database Intern at DBWorks (Mumbai, 4 months): audited 50+ slow queries and added targeted composite indexes
Security & Sanitization: strictly prevented SQL injection via parameterized prepared statements
Video Editing: edited final year project showcase video in Premiere Pro
Linux CLI: analyzed slow query logs using grep, awk, and sed on remote Ubuntu servers
